Rajendra Gudi Mobile : +91-9886121315/98861222246 Email : rajendragudi7@gmail.com Location: Bangalore, India

Summary:

Results-oriented Anaplan & SAP Ariba Consultant with 7.6 years of experience delivering enterprise planning and procurement solutions for global organizations.

Proven expertise in Anaplan model management, ALM deployments, incident resolution, and SAP Ariba, with a strong track record of improving system performance, reducing issue resolution time, and enhancing business efficiency.

Skilled in translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions while collaborating with cross-functional and international teams.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

❖ Anaplan Model Building & DevOps ❖ Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) ❖ SAP Ariba (Sourcing & Contract Management) ❖ SAP MM Configuration & Support ❖ Incident & SLA Management ❖ Model Investigation & Troubleshooting ❖ User Access Management (JML) – Access Provision ❖ Dashboard Development & Optimization ❖ Stakeholder Management & Training

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

Sr Associate IS Architect Amgen Technologies Pvt Ltd | Domain: Anaplan. Nov 2025 – till date

❖ Led Model validation and optimization activities, Ensuring Performance efficiency, formula

accuracy & Scalability across quality, development and production environments.

❖ Performed detailed model comparison between DEV & Prod environments, identifying &

resolving discrepancies in the formula, line item& conditional formatting.

❖ Conducted model clean up activities, identifying duplicate CF Lines and aligning them with

updated business logic and architecture standards.

❖ Creation & updation of technical & functional documentation for Anaplan models ❖ Supported knowledge transfer for forecast related components to support transfer and audit

readiness.

❖ Managed security administration & access provisioning for business users (role – based access),

ensuring appropriate model access and controlled workflow execution.

Anaplan DevOps SME Diageo Business Services India Pvt Ltd| Domain: Anaplan. Sept 2022 – July 2025

❖ Managed and supported 35+ Anaplan production models across Europe, ensuring high

availability and performance

❖ Delivered technical documentation, reducing onboarding time by ~30% and improving usability ❖ Resolved incidents and service requests within SLA, enhancing system stability and user

satisfaction ❖ Implemented changes using ALM, ensuring zero disruption to production environments ❖ Streamlined JML (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) process for secure and compliant access control

Rajendra Gudi Mobile : +91-9886121315/98861222246 Email : rajendragudi7@gmail.com Location: Bangalore, India

❖ ❖ Conducted training sessions for business users, increasing adoption and efficiency

Improved issue resolution efficiency by ~25–35% through proactive troubleshooting

Anaplan Consultant Enquero (Genpact Company) | Client: HP | Domain: Anaplan. July 2021 – May 2022

❖ Designed and enhanced dashboards, improving workflow visibility and decision-making ❖ Built modules, imports, exports, and automated processes to reduce manual effort ❖ Optimized models, improving performance and reducing model size ❖ Delivered bug fixes and enhancements, increasing system reliability ❖ Provided end-user training and ongoing support

Associate SAP Ariba Consultant Bristlecone India Pvt Ltd | Client: SAP Labs | Domain: SAP Ariba. Jan 2020 – June 2021

❖ Supported Ariba Sourcing and Contract Management (Upstream) solutions ❖ Resolved integration issues between SAP Ariba and SAP ECC, minimizing procurement delays ❖ Managed supplier onboarding, linking/unlinking processes ❖ Handled PO failures, connection issues, and ordering errors ❖ Supported UAT, go-live, and post-production support activities ❖ Developed sourcing projects and contract templates aligned with best practices

Associate Consultant Bristlecone India Pvt Ltd | Client: Unilever | Domain: Anaplan. July 2018 – Nov 2019

❖ Managed and supported multiple Anaplan production models, ensuring high availability and

optimal system performance

❖ Resolved incidents and service requests within SLA, minimizing business disruption and

improving user satisfaction

❖ Collaborated with business stakeholders to identify root causes and deliver timely and effective solutions & Increased user adoption through effective communication, training, and quick issue resolution

❖ Performed regular model health checks and data validations to ensure accuracy and consistency

& Supported month-end and business-critical activities, ensuring smooth execution of planning cycles

❖ Managed user access and security (JML – Joiner, Mover, Leaver) with role-based permissions and

selective access

CERTIFICATIONS:

❖ Certified Anaplan Model Builder (Level 1, 2 & 3) ❖ SAP Ariba Procurement Certification ❖ SAP MM Certification

EDUCATION:

Executive MBA – Logistics & Supply Chain Management • B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
